failures.description: A template catalogue entry named chat was presented as a strong AI chat runtime feature.
failures.expected: Catalogue JSON may be described as metadata but must not establish a runtime feature.
failures.actual: AI chat was reported as a strong feature with two symbols.
failures.root_cause: Feature source signals accepted non-executable JSON catalogue content as runtime behavior evidence.
failures.regression_test: tests/V3FeatureEvidenceTest.php — catalogue JSON named chat cannot create AI chat

failures.description: A completed partial scan was stored as a crash after Windows returned -1 from proc_close.
failures.expected: Use the final proc_get_status exit code and preserve the partial scan result.
failures.actual: The corpus record said failed with an empty crash reason.
failures.root_cause: Alpha child-process orchestration discarded the final non-negative exit code on Windows.
failures.regression_test: tests/AlphaRunnerTest.php — successful child exit codes survive delayed Windows process polling

failures.description: Quick analysis exhausted 128 MiB while decoding unbounded TypeScript worker evidence.
failures.expected: Bound worker output, disclose partial evidence, and finish below the memory ceiling.
failures.actual: PHP exhausted memory in NodeWorkerAnalyzerProvider while decoding the worker graph.
failures.root_cause: Node workers emitted unbounded symbol and relationship arrays while PHP retained duplicate input buffers.
failures.regression_test: tests/V3AstTest.php — semantic output is capped before PHP graph decoding

failures.description: Self-dogfood attempted an authentication-gated remote despite an explicitly authorized local repository being available.
failures.expected: Use a static exact-commit detached clone from the authorized local repository.
failures.actual: Safe Git import failed because terminal authentication was disabled.
failures.root_cause: The initial corpus importer only supported anonymous public HTTPS repositories.
failures.regression_test: tests/AlphaRunnerTest.php plus WTFCode exact-commit corpus rerun

failures.description: Documentation and reference URLs inside executable files were reported as runtime external services.
failures.expected: Require endpoint configuration or network-call evidence at the exact source line.
failures.actual: Dozens of documentation sites, placeholders, and malformed hosts appeared as services.
failures.root_cause: Language adapters promoted every URL-shaped string in a runtime-path file without checking line-level execution context.
failures.regression_test: tests/V3FalsePositiveTest.php — comments and website strings do not prove services while API_BASE_URL does

failures.description: Flask was confidently identified as FastAPI because both frameworks support app.get decorators.
failures.expected: Framework identity requires framework-specific import, manifest, or package-path evidence.
failures.actual: The Flask repository stack was FastAPI.
failures.root_cause: A generic Python route decorator was accepted as FastAPI identity evidence.
failures.regression_test: tests/UnitTest.php — generic decorators do not prove FastAPI and explicit Flask evidence does

failures.description: Generic migration plan and service-worker register symbols became Billing and user Registration features.
failures.expected: Feature terms must distinguish product behavior from unrelated technical meanings.
failures.actual: Django showed Billing and a CRUD client showed Registration with strong confidence.
failures.root_cause: Standalone plan and register terms were semantically ambiguous despite multi-signal scoring.
failures.regression_test: tests/V3FeatureEvidenceTest.php — migration plans and service-worker registration stay outside product features

failures.description: Alpha run summaries retained feature labels but omitted the evidence needed for manual truth review.
failures.expected: Store bounded feature paths, lines, signal classes, and confidence without storing source content.
failures.actual: Reviewers had to rerun or grep repositories to understand feature claims.
failures.root_cause: The harness summarized feature counts too aggressively.
failures.regression_test: tests/AlphaRunnerTest.php — every feature summary carries bounded evidence metadata

failures.description: A native detector change reused a pre-change provider cache entry because only the aggregate analysis version changed.
failures.expected: Every native extraction behavior change invalidates native provider cache keys.
failures.actual: The Flask route regression saw a stale graph with zero routes after the adapter was added.
failures.root_cause: AnalysisEngine::NATIVE_VERSION remained unchanged across native detector behavior changes.
failures.regression_test: tests/UnitTest.php plus provider-version cache invalidation coverage

failures.description: Repeated identity and source-text matches promoted framework internals to strong product features without graph or route corroboration.
failures.expected: Strong feature confidence requires an independent graph or route signal; ambiguous technical terms do not establish features.
failures.actual: Flask internals appeared as strong Login and Registration features.
failures.root_cause: Cluster confidence counted repeated symbols as corroboration and feature vocabulary included generic session, register, query, and email terms.
failures.regression_test: tests/V3FeatureEvidenceTest.php plus original Flask corpus rerun

failures.description: Resume validity ignored the Alpha run schema, so old summaries could be reused after evidence fields changed.
failures.expected: Repository SHA, analyzer version, profile, and harness schema must all match before resume skips work.
failures.actual: Alpha.3 runs created before feature evidence was added qualified for reuse.
failures.regression_test: tests/AlphaRunnerTest.php — run schema version is part of the resumable contract
